definitions.explanation: Made or produced by humans rather than occurring naturally. Used as a prefix or modifier for things created through human effort or technology.

examples.japanese: {人工|じんこう}{知能|ちのう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Research on artificial intelligence is advancing.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{湖|みずうみ}→湖：00867_mizuumi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{人工|じんこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ものだ。
{人工|じんこう}{衛星|えいせい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{地球|ちきゅう}→地球：03461_chikyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮影|さつえい}した→撮影する：21990_satsueisuru⟧。
examples.english: Photographs of Earth were taken from an artificial satellite.

notes:
Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧ (population), which uses a different second kanji. {人工|じんこう} uses {工|こう} (craft, construction), while ⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧ uses {口|こう} (mouth, people). Often functions as a prefix in compound nouns.

COMPOUNDS:
- {人工|じんこう}{知能|ちのう} (artificial intelligence, AI)
- {人工|じんこう}{衛星|えいせい} (artificial satellite)
- {人工|じんこう}⟦{呼吸|こきゅう}→呼吸：02754_kokyuu⟧ (artificial respiration)
- {人工|じんこう}⟦{芝|しば}→芝：19341_shiba⟧ (artificial turf)
- {人工|じんこう}{甘味料|かんみりょう} (artificial sweetener)
- {人工|じんこう}{的|てき} (artificial — as a na-adjective)
